ja385:1.1: Sace brāhmaṇa gacchasi Sākete Añjanaṃvanaṃ vajjāsi Nandiyaṃ nāma puttaṃ asmākam orasaṃ: mātāpitā ca te vuddhā, te taṃ icchanti passitun ti.
ja385:2.1: Bhuttā mayā nivāpā rājino pānabhojanaṃ, taṃ rājapiṇḍaṃ avabhottuṃ nāhaṃ brāhmaṇa-m-ussahe.
ja385:3.1: Odahissām' ahaṃ passaṃ khurapāṇissa rājino, tadāhaṃ sukhito mutto api passeyya mātaran ti. Dānaṃ
ja385:5.1: Taṃ maṃ vadhituṃ āgañchi dāyasmiṃ Añjanāvane dhanuṃ adejjhaṃ katvāna usuṃ sandhāya Kosalo.
ja385:6.1: Tassāhaṃ odahiṃ passaṃ khurapāṇissa rājino, tadāhaṃ sukhito mutto mātaraṃ daṭṭhum āgato ti
